scenes.heading: DETECTOR CHEAT, *OR GENIUS?*
scenes.sub: humanizer · AI drafts that sound like you
scenes.say: This model rewrites AI drafts so they read like you wrote them. Honest polish, or a detector cheat?

scenes.heading: MEET *HUMANIZER*
scenes.say: Meet Humanizer, a free local model that rewrites emails, essays and reports in your voice.

scenes.heading: HOW IT *REWRITES*
scenes.say: Paste an AI draft. It rewrites the wording while pinning every number, date and name in place, like the before and after on its page. Then you read it before sending.

scenes.heading: WRITERS *NOTICED*
scenes.say: Writers noticed: nearly two thousand likes and over a hundred thousand downloads.

scenes.heading: *GET THE APP*
scenes.say: There is a free app for Mac and Windows, and it works offline once downloaded.

scenes.heading: THE *HONEST LINE*
cons: Its own tests show some rewrites slip a fact
Passing off AI text as yours is your call
scenes.say: The honest line: its own results show some rewrites still slip a fact, so read first, and passing off AI text as your own writing is your call to make. In return, it runs locally and offline, and it is free and open source.
Would you let AI polish your writing? Comment Human and follow for more.

youtube.description:
humanizer is a 12B local model that rewrites AI-written drafts — emails, essays, reports — so they read like a person wrote them, while pinning numbers, dates and names. Free Mac/Windows app, runs offline. The honest line is in the video: its own evaluation shows some rewrites slip a fact, so read before you send. 1.97k likes, ~110k downloads.
Source: https://huggingface.co/jialinyyzz/humanizer
